elements.name: title
elements.text: The stack follows the lab’s responsibilities

elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: Reuse compatible components and keep AI4R’s research and qualification decisions under our control

elements.name: source
elements.text: Selected direction with explicit qualifications. No platform installation or integrated runtime validation is claimed.

Responsibility	Technology / ownership
Lab boundary and outside stop	Linux VM; qualified hypervisor / provider lifecycle API
Local services and packaged CCs	Docker Engine + Compose; immutable OCI images and persistent volumes
Research, factory and RSI	Lab-owned AI4R version using OpenJiuwen-compatible extension points
Job / tool lifecycle	Stable supervisor; selective JiuwenBox reuse through scoped adapters
Shared model access	Configured API endpoint; vLLM is a serving candidate, not a required backend
Private training and model work	Lab-only model process, private state and a qualified compute allocation

elements.name: takeaway text
elements.text: First proof: continue a research cycle, reuse a CC, stop a runaway job and recover its retained project.
